properties.statement: The failed identity/covering-family approaches transmit solvability only through fixed-modulus congruence relations, which by quadratic reciprocity can eliminate quadratic non-residues but never quadratic residues, so each stalls on the same survivor classes.

properties.preserved_distinctions: es-01 is class-local and constructive (one identity per residue class, never coupling classes), es-02 is global and existential (seeking a finite covering union), and es-10 is mixed local-to-global (aggregating classes into a density bound); sharing the congruence-carrier property does not merge these structurally different postures or operators.
properties.contrast_check: The partial-success es-12 also builds on congruences but explicitly restricts to forms where none of the admitted congruences is a quadratic residue, and its coverage remains self-declared conjectural rather than achieved; es-04, es-09, and es-11 do not transmit solvability through fixed-modulus congruences at all, so the property discriminates failures from the transversal/structural partial successes.
properties.falsification: Exhibiting a fixed-modulus polynomial-identity congruence family that provably solves a quadratic-residue class (e.g., an identity covering an n ≡ 1 (mod 24) survivor class), or a note showing one of these three approaches stalls somewhere other than the quadratic-residue survivor classes.

properties.statement: Several failed approaches produce quantitative evidence of an intrinsically bounded type — a polylog average, a shrinking-but-positive density, or a finite verified range — whose limiting form structurally cannot be upgraded to universal existence.

supporting_passages.quote: polylog average growth is too slow to force existence
argument needs at least polynomial growth

properties.preserved_distinctions: es-05 is probabilistic ensemble averaging over primes, es-07 is deterministic per-instance certification by search, and es-10 is deterministic class assembly; the shared ceiling on their evidence type does not merge their distinct operators (averaging/sieve vs. bounded search vs. class assembly) or uncertainty modes.
properties.contrast_check: The partial-success es-06 also yields almost-all coverage ('covers almost all primes but degrades for perfect-square-like primes'), so 'almost-all coverage' alone would not discriminate; the property is therefore stated as the structural upgrade barrier of the evidence type itself (average growth rate, finite bound, positive residual density), which the notes assert explicitly only for these three.
properties.falsification: A demonstration that one of these evidence types does admit an upgrade path — e.g., an averaging argument whose growth rate forces per-prime existence, or a density argument reaching zero exceptional density — or a note showing the stall was due to effort or computation limits rather than the evidence type.

properties.statement: Two or more stalled approaches reason strictly per-class or per-instance and supply no global organization of the solution set, so their outputs never compose into a statement about all n.

properties.preserved_distinctions: es-01 computes denominators from a closed-form identity with no search, es-03 enumerates divisors of an n-dependent quantity with local congruence filters, and es-07 performs bounded empirical search with certificates; the shared locality does not merge identity evaluation, divisor enumeration, and brute search, which remain distinct mechanisms.
properties.contrast_check: The partial successes are predominantly global or mixed in locality (es-04 mixed, es-06 global, es-09 global, es-11 mixed, es-12 global), so strict per-class/per-instance locality without global organization is held by these stalled approaches and not by the partially successful ones, making it a discriminating property.
properties.falsification: A note showing one of these three approaches derives a genuinely global statement about the full solution set from its local mechanism, or a partially successful approach in the corpus that is equally class-local and unorganized globally yet crosses the survivor classes.

properties.statement: Several stalled approaches break nothing about the underlying congruence/residue structure — their normalized mechanism records list no broken properties — consistent with the obstruction note's claim that every failed family preserves the quadratic-residue wall.

supporting_passages.quote: every failed family here preserves the quadratic-residue wall.

properties.preserved_distinctions: The property concerns only what these mechanisms conserve, not how they operate: es-01 (polynomial identities), es-03 (divisor factorization), and es-10 (density assembly) remain structurally distinct; it also deliberately excludes es-02, a failure that does break class-local isolation yet still stalls, showing break-nothing is not the whole failure story.
properties.contrast_check: The partial successes each record a non-empty break — es-04 and es-12 break 'classification by producing congruence', es-05 breaks per-n constructivity, es-09 breaks surface distinctions between parameterizations — so breaking some inherited structural commitment co-occurs with partial success in this corpus, though es-02 shows a break alone is insufficient.
properties.falsification: A failed approach in the corpus that explicitly breaks the residue/congruence structure it inherits and still stalls at the same wall for that reason, or a partial success whose mechanism record breaks nothing yet crosses the quadratic-residue survivor classes.
